messages:
sam: Quick idea — console should show a 'failure handshake' field that tells clients whether an error is transient, throttle, or terminal. Also surface retry window and suggested backoff. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

maria: +1. We also need a telemetry signal to mark 'retryable' vs 'owner-action' so console + SDK can show consistent UX and drive alerts correctly.

jun: Can we rely on HTTP status + a new header? Something like `X-RW-Status: retryable;retry-after=30`

lee: Prefer structured headers instead of encoded params — e.g. `X-RW-Status: retryable` + standard `Retry-After: 30`. Keeps parsers simple.

sam: Ok. Proposal for minimal contract to start (console + SDK will parse):

```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-RW-Status: throttle
Retry-After: 22
X-RW-Hint: reduce-batch-size
X-RW-Trace: 01F3AB...   # optional, for tracing
```

X-RW-Hint is a short machine-friendly tag we can render into UX tips.

katie: We have a few legacy error shapes in the old runtime. Need a mapping/migration plan so customers don't see noisy UX during rollout.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: rolled out header-parser v0.9 to staging.

maria: Migration plan sketch: create a mapping table (old_code -> X-RW-Status). Enable header emission for 5% sampling on prod for two weeks, collect telemetry, then increase to 100% and flip console to prefer header over old body fields.

jun: Also include `X-RW-Trace` (trace id) in the header for easier correlation between console, logs, and telemetry backends.

lee: Note for Private deployments: some customers strip headers at the edge. SDKs should fallback to `body.error_type` or HTTP status when header absent. Document fallback order.

sam: Agreed. SDK preference order: 1) X-RW-Status header 2) body.error_type 3) HTTP status code. We'll add that to SDK README and changelog.

katie: For the console, propose a compact badge: [Retryable] / [Action required] with hover text populated from X-RW-Hint (localized). I'll mock copy and send to content.

maria: @katie can you mock quick? I'll add telemetry join keys so console shows the sampled examples.

katie: Yep — will mock by EOD.

jun: One more: rollout order should start with high-volume stable routes to maximize signal and avoid spurious UX changes on experimental endpoints.

sam: I'll add a checklist to the RFC draft: header contract, SDK fallback, 5% sampling -> validate metrics (error rate, false positives) -> 100% -> console flip.

ops-bot: incident-bot: If header missing and status >=500, mark `investigate` in alerts.

lee: SG. Also add a small runbook snippet for oncall that shows a query to find recent throttle vs terminal errors:

```
index=redwood-logs | where status_code in (429,500) | stats count by X-RW-Status, route
```

sam: thanks all — filing the RFC now. Will ping when draft is ready for review. :rocket:
